title: Tabular Polygraph
summary: A Hybrid Integrity Framework (HIF) for evaluating logical/semantic consistency of synthetic tabular data beyond distributional fidelity, offering a scorecard covering fidelity, logic, utility, and privacy across generator architectures. It wraps SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (and Gaussian/Vine copula generators) as pluggable synthesizers used to produce the synthetic cohorts it benchmarks and audits.
